ops.title: synckit migration design for daemonkit v0.21.0 — four forks resolved, 8 review defects fixed
ops.body:
Design pass produced 2026-08-03, adversarially reviewed, 8 defects found and fixed in the document.
Attached rather than left in /tmp — cc-notes 5efa42f records this project losing contracts to a /tmp
wipe once already.

synckit is 35 files, ~7,159 lines, 71 distinct withdrawn qualified symbols. Four forks had no
mechanical answer; all four are resolved with cites.

**A — the pool dies, budgets delete.** No synckit site uses pool scheduling: all four worker.Config
sites feed one-shot commands. Budgets map per-call (Cmd.MaxOutput, ctx deadlines).
trust.VerifierWorkerBudgets() dies with the re-exec protocol. Claim/recover/activate and both
Reaper dbs collapse into OwnProcesses (CLI) and Ctx (daemon).

**B — synckit health lane should not exist.** rpc.RuntimeHealth is field-for-field daemonkit Health
via Control.Health/Client.WaitReady, and its only consumer is a test probe (serve_test.go:49) — no
production caller. Deleted, not ported. One field has no successor: RuntimeHealth.Busy, escape
hatch is Ctx.Report/Health.Detail.

**C — split by ownership.** The serve agent is daemonkit-owned (Client.Ensure under the unchanged
label so it adopts the v0.20 install). reconcile + per-manifest helpers are jobs daemonkit does not
own: cc-patch pattern verbatim — launchd.Apply loop failing fast, launchd.Remove loop with
errors.Join, and a durable installed-label record synckit keeps itself for the stray-helper sweep.

**D — delete the verifier re-exec dispatch.** daemon/root.go:24-34 and both TestMain mirrors go.
The spawned transport fence becomes Cmd.Exec: ServingSameUser(); managedPipe moves to Child.Conn().

## The severe review defect, worth reading before any implementation

Uninstall was ordered Remove(reconcile+helpers) → Settle → Remove(serve). Client.Settle "dials
nothing, sends nothing, and never signals" (daemonkit/client.go:45-68) and the serve job is
RestartAlways, so nothing in that sequence stops the daemon and Settle waits out its deadline and
fails ErrUnsettled every run. launchd.Remove bootout is what terminates the incumbent; daemonkit
Ensure does bootout-then-Settle internally (ensure.go:378-396). Corrected to Remove(serve) → Settle.

## Three shape-changers for consumers

1. The socket path moves from Mesh.SockPath() (XDG) to label-derived paths.Socket —
   XDG_CONFIG_HOME no longer isolates tests, and any consumer hardcoding the old path breaks.
2. rpc/protocol.go:19 MaxFrame = 16<<20 carried over verbatim silently caps payloads at ~12 MiB.
   Resize from the payload, pin with MaxDetail. Third consumer to hit this trap.
3. Deleting Client.RuntimeHealth/SpawnedClient/ClientConfig.Dial breaks reposync and cookiesync at
   compile time — coordinate before tagging synckit.
ops.when: Before implementing synckit's migration onto daemonkit v0.21.0
